deprecation_criterion: Superseded by the next packaging-config housekeep wave's baseline; single-use measured-reduction reference for this doc-slim wave.
description: Line counts of packaging-config doc surfaces. spec.md peaked at 588 lines when it carried 17 historical `## Plugin patch/minor vX.Y.Z` release-note sections (v0.5.0 -> v0.8.0). Per coding-rules and the principle that history belongs in docs/CHANGELOG.md never in the doc surface, those 17 release-note sections were removed from spec.md and folded into docs/CHANGELOG.md, re-anchoring spec.md to 305 lines (living spec only: Purpose, paths, public surface, current behavior, invariants; every load-bearing token preserved verbatim). This baseline is re-anchored to that reduced spec.md line count so the no-growth gate stays consistent. The housekeep e2e test asserts the current docs are no LARGER than these baselines (a reduced|no-op verdict), spec.md is not larger, and the load-bearing tokens survived the slim.
